coach_says: TSB is -55.5 and Garmin reports UNPRODUCTIVE status with declining fitness trend, so this week prioritises recovery over progression despite the aerobic-high shortage flag. The only quality/hard session is Tuesday's committed MTB group ride; Tuesday's optional hills ride is downgraded to an easy spin to avoid a true double-hard day. Everything else is easy endurance, yoga, swim, and lightened gym work to rebuild before adding intensity back next week.

days.details:
Weather unsuitable for riding (drizzle). Loads reduced this week, 2-3 RIR on all sets, nothing near failure.

Workout A:
Warm-up: 5-10 min easy bike + dynamic mobility

Romanian Deadlift 3x6 (moderate load)
Bulgarian Split Squat 3x8
Chest Supported Row 3x10
Dumbbell Bench Press 3x10
Copenhagen Plank 3x20 sec
Dead Bug 2x8 each side

Main lifts: 2 min rest
Accessories: 60-90 sec rest

days.session: AM easy spin + PM committed hard MTB group ride
days.details:
Before work: 40 min | Objective: easy leg flush, strictly Zone 1-2, no intensity, flat terrain.

Evening (non-negotiable committed session): Hard MTB group ride, ~75 min, variable terrain with hard surges/climbs. This is the week's single designated quality session - go by feel given current fatigue, but do not skip. This is the only hard day this week; morning ride kept deliberately easy to avoid a true double-hard day.
Mandatory easy/recovery day following Tuesday's double session. 35 min gentle flow yoga focusing on hips, thoracic spine and hamstrings. No cycling today - full recovery from MTB group ride.

Warmup: 200m easy freestyle
Main: 4x150m (first 50m easy / next 100m moderate), 20 sec rest
Cooldown: 100m easy
Total: ~1000m
Keep 'moderate' segments truly moderate - this is an aerobic recovery swim, not a hard session.

Wettest day of the week (41% rain), outdoor riding skipped. Loads kept moderate, 2-3 RIR throughout.

Workout B:
Warm-up: 5-10 min easy bike + dynamic mobility

Trap Bar Deadlift 3x5 (moderate load)
Reverse Lunge 3x8 each leg
Lat Pulldown 3x10
Landmine Press 3x10
Pallof Press 3x10 each side
Farmer Carry 3x30m

Main lifts: 2 min rest
Accessories: 60-90 sec rest

120 min | Objective: Aerobic endurance (recovery week - strict Zone 1-2, no hard efforts)
15 min Zone 1 warm-up
90 min Zone 2 steady, flat/rolling terrain
15 min Zone 1 cool-down
Ideal weather (clear, low wind) - use for pure aerobic base, resist urge to push pace given current fatigue status.

90 min | Objective: Easy aerobic MTB, skills/technical focus, no hard efforts
15 min Zone 1 warm-up
60 min Zone 1-2 trail riding, avoid sustained hard climbs or sprints
15 min Zone 1 cool-down
Enjoyable low-key ride to close out the recovery-focused week before reintroducing quality volume.
